sections.title: 1. What LOSPOR is for
paragraphs: LOSPOR is a personal anaesthetic case log and perioperative data platform for documentation, learning, professional development, audit, and pseudonymised research export.

sections.title: 2. What you must not enter
paragraphs: Do not enter patient names, national identifiers, hospital record numbers, dates of birth, contact details, addresses, or other direct patient-identifying information in any field or uploaded image.
sections.warning: LOSPOR is not a hospital medical record system. The hospital medical record remains the authoritative patient record.

sections.title: 3. Your account
paragraphs: Use the account individually and keep its credentials secure. Verify the account email before signing in. Account deletion disables access immediately; further deletion or anonymisation follows the applicable retention policy.

sections.title: 4. AI image scanning
paragraphs: Treat optional AI extraction from laboratory reports and anaesthesia monitors as a draft for clinician review. Do not use it as the sole basis for diagnosis, treatment, or documentation. Crop or obscure identifiers before upload.

sections.title: 5. Medical disclaimer
paragraphs: Use LOSPOR only for perioperative documentation, research, and workflow support. It does not replace clinical judgement, make autonomous clinical decisions, or constitute a certified medical device.

sections.title: 6. Liability
paragraphs: LOSPOR is provided as is without warranty. The operator accepts no liability for clinical decisions made using or based on LOSPOR. Use the service at your own professional risk.

sections.title: 7. Open source
paragraphs: LOSPOR is published under AGPL-3.0. If you self-host a modified version, publish the source code of the modifications under the same licence.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: LOSPOR is an independent tool operated by Kaloyan Dzhunov (kaloyandjunow@gmail.com).

Controller and processor roles depend on the purposes and means of each processing activity. In most deployments, the treating institution or clinician controls the clinical records entered while the operator maintains the infrastructure. Joint controllership may arise where the operator determines purposes of its own. Each deploying institution must complete its role mapping, Articles 6 and 9 legal-basis assessment, and any required data protection impact assessment.

bullets.label: Account data
bullets.text: name, email address, title, institution, registration date, last login time, role, interface preferences, and legal acceptance records.

bullets.label: Case data
bullets.text: structured perioperative fields, normalised research rows, append-only intraoperative events, timestamps, institution linkage, and audit metadata. Direct identifiers are not intended to be collected. Case data is pseudonymised, not anonymous, and can remain personal data under the GDPR.

bullets.label: Audit log
bullets.text: case creation, update, deletion, AI use, export, and account events.

bullets.label: Session data
bullets.text: short-lived HttpOnly Web and PWA session cookies and revocable native-Mobile bearer tokens. Browser session cookies are not available to browser scripts.

bullets.label: PWA device data
bullets.text: interface preferences, offline drafts, queued saves, and queued intraoperative events may remain in browser storage until logout or successful synchronisation.

bullets.label: Account emails
bullets.text: the email address is used for verification and password-reset links. Their tokens are stored hashed, expire, and are single-use.

bullets.label: Account data
bullets.text: the legal basis depends on the deployment and may include performance of a service, legitimate interests, or consent where appropriate.

bullets.label: Case data
bullets.text: the deploying controller must identify and document the applicable Articles 6 and 9 bases before clinical use.

bullets.label: Mistral AI
bullets.text: opt-in image and structured-advisor inference. Remove identifiers before any image upload.

bullets.label: Brevo
bullets.text: transactional account email delivery; only the required name and email data are shared for delivery.
Case data is retained while the account is active and then handled under the applicable institutional or research retention policy.
Audit records are retained for security, integrity, and medico-legal traceability under the applicable policy.
Account deletion disables access immediately. Further deletion or anonymisation follows the applicable retention policy.

bullets.label: Access
bullets.text: download the personal account and case archive from Settings — Privacy & Data.

bullets.label: Deletion
bullets.text: request account deletion from Settings — Privacy & Data.
For other requests, contact kaloyandjunow@gmail.com or the controller identified by the deploying institution.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: Passwords are hashed. Sessions are short-lived and revocable. Traffic is encrypted over HTTPS. Server-side checks look for common identifying patterns in free text, but no automated check guarantees that every identifier will be detected.
